abilities.critical_failure: As failure, and the PC is stunned 1.
abilities.effect: Creatures in area F2 are thrown hundreds of feet from the peak of the Ox's horn onto its back. Each creature takes falling damage as if they fell 60 feet (30 bludgeoning damage), with a 31 Reflex save. Creatures can arrest their fall with spells like gentle landing, as normal. In addition, the result determines how far the PC must travel in order to escape the Ox's tail in the Swatted Like Flies hazard.
abilities.name: Shake
abilities.trigger: The Granite Ox awakens from slumber

hazard.description: The Granite Ox shakes off centuries of accumulated earth, flinging the PCs toward its hindquarters.
hazard.name: Shaken Loose

traits.name: Unique
traits.text: A rules element with this trait is one-of-a-kind. The DC of Recall Knowledge checks related to creatures with this trait is increased by 10.

traits.name: Elemental
traits.text: Elementals are creatures directly tied to an element and native to the elemental planes. Elementals don’t need to breathe.

traits.name: Mythic
traits.text:
Options with this trait grant or utilize mythic power. Feats with the mythic trait can only be taken by mythic characters, who are typically characters with a mythic Calling.  
  
 Monsters with the mythic trait have access to a pool of Mythic Points and are particularly strong for creatures of their level. Many mythic monsters are either resistant or entirely immune to attacks from non-mythic creatures and weapons.  
  
 Spells with the mythic trait require the expenditure of a Mythic Point in order to be cast, and items with the mythic trait require the expenditure of a Mythic Point in order to use their activated abilities.  
  
 Weapons with the mythic trait overcome the resistances and immunities of mythic monsters.
